description: This 30-metre raster estimates construction-land suitability across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Researchers at the Institute of Geographic Sciences and Natural Resources Research and the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences combine a human-activity suitability model with FABDEM terrain data. The published result distinguishes five suitability classes and includes a scaled numerical suitability measure. ScienceDB distributes the FGDBR raster format free under CC BY 4.0. Its metadata specifies an unsigned integer representation and a scaling factor of 0.000001; the temporal reference of all input layers remains uncertain. The map represents modelled terrain-related suitability and does not grant planning permission or account for every development constraint. It can restrict candidate settlement or facility locations in spatial planning simulations. No directly related catalogue record was found.
name: A dataset of spatial distribution of construction land suitability with a spatial resolution of 30m on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
